policy_note: V17 preserves the review-only policy at the rules level; the stratum-unanimous propagation described in profile_note is enforced by delivery_orchestrator.py (calibration report + prediction manifest layer), not by candidate rules themselves.
profile_note: V17 keeps V16's conservative nomination principles (sentence-internal filler preserved, acknowledgement 嗯 preserved, cross-track guard unchanged, rendering_gate 100 ms) but widens the four nomination gates that were empirically starving the candidate pool. Under V16 the EP04 v20 run frozen only 5 reviewable candidates across three families, each on its own stratum. Because each stratum contained a single candidate, the delivery_orchestrator stratum-unanimous propagation mechanism (which requires unreviewed peers inside the same stratum) could not fire, and machine_assisted_draft became identical to human_approved — defeating the core product goal (human审高风险 + 机器根据经验propagate低风险). V17 widens gates so each family produces 15-30 candidates, several strata each with 3+ members, letting real reviewers audit stratum representatives while unanimous strata propagate the rest as machine_proposed_accept. Autocut policy remains NOT_APPROVED so nothing leaves machine_assisted_draft without a signed policy or explicit human whole-episode approval.

provenance.empirical_gap: V16 nomination gates produced 5 candidates on 5 distinct strata; orchestrator stratum-unanimous propagation requires >=2 members per stratum with >=1 human sample; therefore machine_proposed_accept always resolved to 0.
preserved_from_v16: strong_tokens list (no expansion; avoids '额度' first-char false positive)

filler_hesitation.note: V17 widens window/gap/density to enlarge candidate pool for stratum propagation. Sentence-internal single filler and single 嗯 still preserved via D6 and acknowledgement_handling.

immediate_repetition.note: V17 widens phrase length to 2-6 chars and gap to 0.60 s. Symmetric neighboring repetition remains reviewable, not silently dropped. First occurrence proposed for removal, second retained.

sentence_position_gate.note: Unchanged from V16. D6 protects sentence completeness for filler only. D8 explicitly exempts immediate_repetition.

confidence_policy.note: Unchanged from V16. Machine cuts still gated by delivery_orchestrator stratum-unanimous propagation and NOT_APPROVED autocut_policy; V17 widening only affects nomination, not automatic approval.

global_long_pause.note: V17 lowers min_silence_seconds from 1.5 to 1.10 to surface more common-silence windows for stratum propagation. Boundary retention ladder unchanged. Compress-not-delete principle unchanged; A/B still required.

cross_track_guard.note: Unchanged from V16. Any different word on another track blocks global cut.
